info.title: Tagg@d API
info.description: API documentation for the Tagg@d backend — a crypto payment platform for Africa.

assetIssuer.description: Stellar asset issuer (required for non-native assets)

secret.description: Optional custom signing secret. If omitted, one will be generated.

WebhookEventPayload.description: Payload delivered to webhook URL on each event

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature for verifying payload authenticity

get.summary: New and cumulative user growth by period
Transaction count and volume time series
High-level dashboard summary (volume, success rate, users)
Full analytics overview (summary + volume trend + top tokens/chains)
Top tokens by volume and transaction count
Top chains by transaction count and volume

post.description: Generate an API key with specified scopes for third-party access. The key is returned only once — store it securely.

scopes.description: Comma-separated scopes (transactions:read, transactions:write, payments:send, webhooks:read, webhooks:write)

ipWhitelist.description: Comma-separated IP addresses or CIDR ranges

expiresIn.description: Number of days until the key expires

get.summary: List all API keys for the authenticated user
Get a specific API key by ID

patch.description: Update the name, scopes, IP whitelist, or rotation interval of an existing API key.

delete.description: Permanently revoke an API key. All requests using this key will be rejected.

get.summary: Get usage statistics for an API key
Get rotation logs for an API key

post.description: Creates a new key and revokes the old one. The new key is returned only once.

200.description: Key rotated successfully — new key returned

delete.description: Remove audit logs older than a specified retention period.

get.summary: List audit logs with filtering and pagination
Get a specific audit log entry

post.description: Create a new Tagg@d account. Requires email and password. Returns a JWT token on success.

post.summary: Login user and get JWT token
post.description: Authenticate with email/password. If 2FA is enabled, include the `twoFactorToken`. Returns a JWT bearer token.

twoFactorToken.description: 6-digit OTP from authenticator app (required if 2FA is enabled)

post.description: Authenticate using a Google OAuth token. The token is verified against Google's OAuth API and a Tagg@d JWT is returned.

googleToken.description: Google OAuth access token obtained from the frontend Google Sign-In flow

post.description: Generate a TOTP secret and QR code for enabling 2FA. Returns a base32 secret and a QR code URL for the authenticator app.
Confirm 2FA setup by providing the first TOTP code from your authenticator app. After enabling, the `twoFactorToken` will be required for all future logins.
Verify a TOTP token from the authenticator app. Used to validate 2FA during sensitive operations like withdrawals.

get.description: Returns a list of recent database backups including local and S3 storage, encryption status, and file sizes. Admin access required.

200.description: Portfolio summary with aggregated USD and NGN values

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's linked bank accounts
Get a specific bank account by ID

post.description: Send payments to multiple recipients in a single atomic or non-atomic batch. Max 100 payments per batch.

atomic.description: If true, the entire batch succeeds or fails together

assetIssuer.description: Stellar asset issuer (required for custom assets)

get.description: Check the processing status and results of a batch payment.
Returns all available bill payment categories (airtime, data, TV, electricity, betting).

get.summary: List providers for a bill category
get.description: Returns all available service providers for a specific category (e.g., MTN, Airtel for airtime; DSTV, GOTV for TV).

200.description: List of providers for the category

post.description: Initiate a bill payment. Requires authentication and rate-limited to 5 requests per minute.
Add a new supported blockchain chain to the platform.

get.description: Returns all supported chains with their configuration. Cached for 1 hour.

get.summary: Get a specific chain by ID
Get circuit breaker statistics for all services
get.description: Returns the current state (open, half-open, closed) and failure counts for each monitored blockchain service.

post.summary: Reset a circuit breaker for a specific service
post.description: Manually reset a circuit breaker from open/half-open state back to closed. Use with caution.

parameters.name: serviceKey
parameters.description: Service key to reset (e.g., stellar_payment, evm_transfer)

message.example: Circuit breaker for stellar_payment has been reset

get.description: Returns aggregate statistics on dispute counts, resolution times, and category breakdown.

post.description: Open a dispute for a specific transaction. Requires the transaction ID, reason, and category.

description.example: I sent 50 USDC to @bob but the funds never arrived in their wallet

get.description: Users see their own disputes; admins see all disputes. Supports filtering and pagination.

get.summary: Get a specific dispute by ID

patch.description: Change the dispute status and optionally add a resolution note.

resolution_note.example: Payment was delayed due to network congestion; funds have now been delivered.

post.description: Escalate an open dispute to a higher priority level with a detailed reason.

reason.example: The recipient has not responded in 48 hours and the funds appear stuck on-chain.

patch.summary: Assign a dispute to an admin
patch.description: Assign an open or under-review dispute to a specific admin for resolution.

post.summary: Add a comment to a dispute

comment.example: I've checked the on-chain transaction and the funds were indeed sent but haven't been credited.

get.description: Calculate the fee breakdown for a bank, crypto, or tag withdrawal based on the type, chain, token, and amount.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Blockchain chain (e.g., base, xlm, lisk, flow, u2u, starknet)

platformFee.description: Platform fee in the withdrawal currency

feePercentage.description: Fee as percentage of withdrawal amount

get.description: Returns all configured fee structures for each withdrawal type, chain, and token combination.

post.summary: Upload a file (KYC document, profile image, etc.)

post.description: Register a unique @tag and associate it with a blockchain wallet address.

post.summary: Resolve a @tag to its wallet address
Send funds to a wallet address

post.description: Verify a customer's details before processing a bill payment (e.g., smart card number for TV, meter number for electricity).

get.description: Returns current crypto-to-fiat exchange rates. Cached for 15 minutes.
Convert an amount between any supported currencies (crypto or fiat).
Returns the current USD-to-NGN exchange rate from cache.

200.description: System is ready to accept traffic

get.summary: List available API versions and their deprecation status

post.summary: Register signing keys for a blockchain wallet
post.description: Register cryptographic signing keys needed for on-chain transactions on supported chains (Stellar, EVM, Starknet).

stellarPublicKey.description: Stellar public key for signing transactions

post.description: Submit identity verification documents (passport, selfie, address proof) for KYC review. Required for withdrawals and higher transaction limits.

idType.description: Type of ID document (passport, drivers_license, national_id)

200.description: KYC record for the authenticated user

get.description: Returns whether the user's KYC is pending, approved, or rejected. Approved KYC is required for bank withdrawals.

put.description: Update or resubmit KYC documents after rejection.

post.description: Admin-only endpoint to approve a pending KYC submission, enabling the user to access withdrawals and higher transaction limits.
Admin-only endpoint to reject a KYC submission with a reason. The user will be notified and can resubmit.

reason.example: Document image is blurry. Please resubmit with a clearer photo.

get.description: List all notifications for the authenticated user, sorted by newest first.
Retrieve the user's current notification preferences (push, email, in-app).

put.description: Toggle push, email, or in-app notification channels.

post.summary: Register a push notification device token
post.description: Register a Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) device token for receiving push notifications.

delete.summary: Unregister a push notification device token
delete.description: Remove a device token to stop sending push notifications to that device.

get.description: Returns response time averages, request counts, error rates, and resource utilization metrics. Admin access required.

post.description: Reset all accumulated performance counters to zero. Admin access required.

get.description: Returns the configured rate limit thresholds for each endpoint tier.

get.summary: Get a user's rate limit status
get.description: Returns the current rate limit counters and remaining quota for a specific user.

put.summary: Update a user's rate limit tier
put.description: Change a user's rate limit tier (e.g., from free to premium) to adjust their quota.

get.summary: Get an API key's rate limit status

put.summary: Update an API key's rate limit configuration

get.description: Returns a log of recent rate limit violations across all users and API keys.

post.description: Schedule a payment to be executed at a future date. The scheduled date must be within 30 days from now.

assetIssuer.description: Stellar asset issuer address (required for custom assets)

scheduledAt.description: ISO datetime when payment should execute (must be in the future, max 30 days)

400.description: Validation error (e.g., scheduled date in past)

get.description: Returns all scheduled payments for the authenticated user, with optional status filtering.
Returns scheduled payments that are due to execute soon.

patch.description: Cancel a pending scheduled payment. Only payments with status "pending" can be cancelled.

400.description: Cannot cancel a payment that is not pending

get.description: Search registered tags by name. Rate-limited to 10 requests per minute per IP.

post.description: Create and register a unique @tag for a user. The tag must be 3-20 alphanumeric characters (underscores allowed).

userId.description: User ID to associate with the tag

400.description: Validation error or tag already taken

get.summary: Check if a tag is available for registration
get.description: Returns whether a specific tag name is available (not yet registered).

get.summary: Resolve a tag to its wallet address
get.description: Given a @tag, return the associated wallet address and chain information.

put.summary: Transfer a tag to another user
put.description: Transfer ownership of a @tag to a different user. Requires authentication as the current tag owner.

429.description: Search rate limit exceeded (30 per minute)

get.description: Full-text and filtered search across transaction history. Supports keyword search, status/chain/token filters, amount ranges, and date ranges. Returns cursor-based paginated results.
Returns paginated transaction history for the authenticated user. Supports `transactions:read` scope for API keys.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag name to query transactions for

get.summary: Get a specific transaction by ID

put.summary: Update a transaction (e.g., add a note)

post.description: Send a payment from one @tag to another. Supports XLM and custom Stellar assets. Requires `transactions:write` or `payments:send` scope.

get.description: Returns the minimum and maximum payment amounts, fee percentages, and other limit configurations.
Same filter parameters as search, but returns all matching results as a downloadable CSV file instead of paginated JSON.

post.description: Public endpoint that receives USSD session data from the mobile network gateway. Handles menu navigation, balance checks, and payment initiation via USSD codes.

text.description: USSD input text from the user's menu selections

get.description: Returns session counts, active users, and transaction volume via USSD. Admin access required.
Returns all wallets and balances associated with the authenticated user across all supported chains.

post.summary: Send funds to another user via @tag
post.description: Transfer tokens to another registered user's @tag on any supported chain (base, lisk, flow, u2u, starknet). For Flow, uses Flow EVM (0x + 16 hex chars).

amount.description: Amount to send (positive, up to 18 decimal places)

balance_id.description: Sender's balance record ID (determines chain + token)

post.summary: Send funds to an external blockchain address
post.description: Withdraw tokens to an external wallet address on any supported chain. Flow EVM addresses must be 0x followed by exactly 16 hex characters (e.g. 0x1234567890abcdef). Requires 2FA.

receiver_address.description: Destination blockchain address. Format depends on chain: Flow EVM: 0x + 16 hex chars, EVM chains: 0x + 40 hex chars, Starknet: 0x + up to 64 hex chars

400.description: Invalid address format or missing fields

get.summary: Get a specific wallet by ID

get.description: Returns all webhook events that failed delivery and exhausted retry attempts. Admin access required.

post.description: Manually retry a failed webhook delivery event from the DLQ. Admin access required.

get.description: Public endpoint returning all event types that can be subscribed to via webhooks.

post.description: Public utility endpoint to verify that a webhook payload was signed with the correct secret. Useful for debugging webhook integrations.

payload.description: The webhook payload body to verify

signature.description: The HMAC-SHA256 signature received in the webhook header

post.description: Create a webhook subscription to receive event notifications at a specified URL. Requires `webhooks:write` scope for API key authentication.

201.description: Webhook registered successfully. The secret is returned only once.

message.example: Webhook registered. Store the secret — it will not be shown again.

get.description: Returns all webhook subscriptions for the authenticated user. Requires `webhooks:read` scope for API keys.

get.summary: Get a specific webhook by ID

put.description: Update the URL, events, or active status of an existing webhook. Requires `webhooks:write` scope.

delete.description: Permanently remove a webhook subscription. Requires `webhooks:write` scope.

post.description: Generate a new signing secret for a webhook. The old secret will no longer be valid. Requires `webhooks:write` scope.

200.description: Secret rotated successfully. New secret returned only once.

get.description: Returns the delivery history (status, attempts, timestamps) for a webhook. Requires `webhooks:read` scope.

post.description: Start a fiat withdrawal from crypto balance to a linked Nigerian bank account. Creates a withdrawal request that will be processed via Paystack or Monnify.

bankAccountId.description: ID of the linked bank account to receive funds

get.description: List all withdrawal requests for the authenticated user.

post.description: Webhook endpoint for Paystack to notify the platform about withdrawal status changes. This endpoint is public (no auth required) and validates the Paystack signature.
Webhook endpoint for Monnify to notify the platform about withdrawal status changes. This endpoint is public (no auth required) and validates the Monnify signature.
